11. What is the normal flow of execution of a Java program?
A Java program normally executes statements one after another, line by line.
12. What is linear flow of execution?
Linear flow means statements execute one after another in sequence.
Control constructs are required when we do not want normal linear execution.
They help us decide which statements should execute and which statements should be skipped.
A control construct is used to construct the flow of control according to the programmer's requirement.
